{{Infobox auto}}
The '''blast furnace''' is the hottest smelting station and the only one that smelts iron, gold, silver and diamonds.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
The vanilla recipe is replaced: 4 polished deepslate, 2 smooth stone and a [[Kindling|kindling]] (campfire), with no iron or furnace.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/blast_furnace.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
It smelts raw iron, raw gold, [[Raw Silver|raw silver]], [[Raw Diamond|raw diamonds]], [[Carbon-Rich Iron|carbon-rich iron]], ancient debris and several stone blocks, and melts metal equipment back into ingots, diamonds or [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]]. Obtaining one grants ''Burgeoning Metallurge''.
